record.title: UC Center Sacramento (UCCS) Program
record.description: The UCCS program provides undergraduate students the opportunity to combine academics, research, and public service through internships in the Sacramento policy community, government departments, and agencies, while taking mandatory coursework.

eligibility.raw_text: Work as an intern for about 20 hours per week

record.application_method: Online application via the link provided on the UC Center Sacramento website.

record.title: AIP Enrollment Workshop
record.organization: Experiential Learning, Teaching and Learning Commons
record.description: Learn about your internship course options offered through Academic Internship Program and get support with enrollment ahead of AIP's deadlines.

record.title: Basement Affiliate Student Organization Program
record.description: The Basement Affiliate Student Organization Program is designed to foster meaningful partnerships with student organizations that are passionate about entrepreneurship, innovation, and design knowledge.

eligibility.value: registered with UC San Diego’s Center for Student Involvement
eligibility.raw_text: The organization must be registered and in good standing with UC San Diego’s Center for Student Involvement (CSI).
The organization should have an active member base and demonstrate consistent engagement throughout the academic year.

record.application_method: Complete the Affiliate Agreement Form, signed by all Executive Board
